LanguageData.CC_Elect_AnnounceByTextMany: Seats on the council stand empty, and the colony will vote to fill them on election day, the {DATE}. Until then the candidates will make their case to people in their free time. On the day itself everyone at home who is up to it casts a vote {VENUE}, and that evening the candidates speak there and the votes are counted aloud.
LanguageData.CC_Election_ByTextMany: Seats on the council stood empty, so the colony voted to fill them.
LanguageData.CC_PM_Appoint_ByTextMany: Seats on the council stood empty. By the colony's beliefs they are not put to a vote: {PAWN_nameDef}, who leads the colony, named people to fill them.
LanguageData.CC_Elect_CeremonyByTextMany: Seats on the council stand empty, and only one person can take each of them. On the evening of the {DATE}, {CHAIR} will name them to their seats at a short ceremony {VENUE}.
